t: Heart in the Sky at NASA Kennedy

img.cap: A white, heart-shaped smoke trail from airplanes is in the sky on the left of the massive, square Vehicle Assembly Building at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

p: NASA/Amber Jean Notvest The U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds create a heart-shaped smoke trail during a flight maneuver near NASA’s Vehicle Assembly Building during the agency’s

p.t: MAX POWER expo and air show

p: on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
NASA’s MAX POWER is an aerospace festival celebrating the past, present, and future of flight and space exploration in honor of America’s 250th anniversary.
